candidate.competition_identification: unweighted sum of fitted competition deviations equals zero separately for delta and eta

goals_only_reference.use: algorithm held fixed; refit only inside authorized development folds

raw_v5_npxg_benchmark.use: algorithm held fixed; refit only inside authorized development folds

dixon_coles.normalization: analytic Dixon-Coles mass is one; reject if absolute computed mass error exceeds 1e-12

features.competition_center: arithmetic mean from valid matches in the same competition-season with kickoff strictly before the target batch; global strictly-prior mean only for an unseen competition
features.missing_behavior: target not forecastable; never impute team state
features.npxg: raw expected_goals summed after excluding provider-labelled Penalty situations and is_own_goal=true
features.opponent_interaction: own rolling for state is paired with opponent rolling against state in each log rate
features.weighting: equal weight for each of the last 10 valid appearances

fitting.objective: mean negative Dixon-Coles joint-score log likelihood plus frozen L2 penalties
fitting.selection: lowest mean inner three-block chronological joint-score log loss; ties within 1e-12 choose the earlier listed candidate

probability_outputs.score_matrix: 0 through 9 plus 10+ on each axis; tail rows and columns use exact Poisson marginal tail masses; low-score corrections applied before aggregation
probability_outputs.total_goal_crps: CDF sum for totals 0 through 19; remaining tail is represented by the final complement
probability_outputs.one_x_two: independent Skellam probabilities plus exact Dixon-Coles mass deltas in corrected cells

validation.chronological: four contiguous kickoff-batch blocks per domain; each scored block uses only fit rows with kickoff strictly before the block start
validation.leave_domain_out: five outer folds; exclude every row from the scored competition-season; train and select only on other-domain rows strictly before each scored block start
validation.leave_team_out: exclude both scored teams' match outcomes from fitting while retaining their strictly-prior rolling state; score every eligible row once by the lexicographically smaller participating team ID to avoid duplicate weighting
validation.same_kickoff: build and freeze every forecast in a kickoff batch before revealing any outcome in that batch
